name: Codex (out of process)
description: Runs OpenAI Codex as an app-server in its own process, over Studio's agent protocol.
detail: Holds a Codex thread open across turns, so a conversation keeps its context. Streams replies, reasoning, shell commands, file changes and web searches into the transcript, and asks you through Studio's permission card before a command runs or a file changes, under your posture and per-tool settings. Authenticates through your local Codex login, or through an API key configured against the connection.

providers.description: Run OpenAI models through your Codex subscription (local login).

authMethods.hint: Uses your local Codex login (~/.codex) through the OpenAI Codex CLI.
